$comment: Inclusive master-pixel boxes. The upper region includes hair and hands; legs remain fixed.

head.note: Head including ears; excludes the long ponytail.

face.note: Open blue eyes; mouth endpoints raised one master pixel.

upper.note: Head, torso and hands move most; skirt bands follow with smaller lifts.

skirt-middle.note: Middle skirt follows at two thirds of the upper-body lift.

skirt-lower.note: Hem follows at one third of the upper-body lift; feet stay planted.

legs.note: Fixed legs and shoes, inclusive bounds.
